system.description: Spend two Blood Traits; after one turn you become fully insubstantial while remaining visible and able to speak, passing through walls, floors, and physical attacks (fire and sunlight damage becomes lethal instead of aggravated). You may float, sink through floors, or move no faster than walking pace while incorporeal, and may use any Disciplines that don't require physical contact or a solid body, but cannot manipulate your environment unless you also possess the Thaumaturgy path of Movement of the Mind.
